description: A biconditional is satisfied exactly when its two formulas have equivalent truth values.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_iff.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  {α : Type u'} {l : ℕ} {φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α l} {v : α → M} {xs : Fin l → M} :
  (φ.iff ψ).Realize v xs ↔ (φ.Realize v xs ↔ ψ.Realize v xs)
